messages:
Alisa (partnerships): Uploaded CoreWare's HW pricing + supply CSV. Need inputs for: reserved SKUs, spot preemption windows, and the trial grant mechanics (they're offering pooled trial SKUs). Can we map these into the cost model by EOW?

Miguel (finance): Thanks — quick ask: do we have their committed/reserved pricing tiers or just list/spot? For cost model we need: committed price, committed qty, spot floor, spot volatility estimate (pct). Also how they handle true-ups and prorated credits.

CoreWare_SalesBot: Link: https://files.coreware.example/ccw-hw-terms-2026.csv (uploaded)

Priya (vendor-ops): TL;DR from vendor: committed tiers at 3 tenors (30/90/365 days). Committed price = list * (0.6 / 0.55 / 0.45) depending on tenor. Spot availability varies by region; they send a weekly availability signal and a 10% bucket that is preemptible within 2-6 hours. Trial SKUs are provided as "grant credits" up to 1000 GPU-min per account for 30 days.

Miguel (finance): Ok can we get a CSV extract with columns: sku, region, committed_tenor_days, committed_qty, committed_unit_price_usd, spot_floor_usd, spot_eviction_window_hours, trial_grant_limit_gpu_min? If they can't provide exact numbers for volatility, give us historic spot price stdev over past 90d.

Alisa (partnerships): Priya can you push that extract? Also note: marketplace listing fee (per-SKU) and billback/rebate mechanics — CoreWare wants billback if usage > committed by >20% in any month.

Priya (vendor-ops): On it. One nuance: billback is applied as a negative credit on next invoice; there's also a "grace conversion" where we convert trial grant usage into 50% discounted committed usage if customer converts within 45 days. We'll add a column trial_convert_ratio.

Tom (legal): Heads-up: we need the contract language for the trial -> paid conversion and the exact wording for evictions. Specifically: is there a guaranteed eviction notice (e.g., webhook with 5m warning), or is it best-effort? That changes how we model SLA credits.

Priya (vendor-ops): Legal confirmed: evictions are best-effort; they provide a signal feed but no hard SLA for preemption alerts. They will commit to a max 6h eviction window for the 10% preemptible pool. We'll attach the legal excerpt.

Jae (product): For Redwood's cost model and marketplace storefront we need: mapping from CoreWare SKUs -> Redwood model flavors (e.g., cwr-v100-80g -> rdx-gpu-xlarge). Also listing fee per-sku and per-region. That affects unit economics in the UI.

Miguel (finance): Also confirm billing cadence: CoreWare invoices monthly; true-ups are reconciled in next invoice. Does CoreWare provide per-customer usage CSVs or only account-level aggregates? We need per-customer lines for marketplace billing.

Priya (vendor-ops): They can provide per-customer usage exports in a standard CSV (customer_id, sku, region, start_ts, end_ts, gpu_min_used). We'll ask for schema and sample.

Alisa (partnerships): Great. Action items:
- Priya: push the detailed CSV extract with the columns Miguel asked for + trial_convert_ratio + per-customer sample (due: +2 business days).
- Tom: draft contract ask re: explicit notice webhook (we'll request but they already said no hard SLA).
- Miguel/Jae: update cost model mapping once CSV arrives; flag any SKU mismatches.

Priya (vendor-ops): Uploaded sample CSV to the shared folder and pinged CoreWare ops to confirm per-customer export. Link: https://files.coreware.example/ccw-sample-export.csv

Miguel (finance): Quick modeling note: for the spot floor we should run two scenarios: conservative (spot floor = list * 0.3) and optimistic (spot floor = vendor spot_floor column). Also model the trial grant conversion as two paths: 0% convert and 25% convert to committed usage within 45 days.

Alisa (partnerships): Good call. I'll slot this into the Partners cost model workbook and run the scenario sweep. Can folks review the workbook when I post?

Tom (legal): Posted a short clause snippet to request: "Partner will provide advance eviction signal via webhook where operationally possible; where not possible, partner will provide post-eviction telemetry and a remediation credit policy." Recommend we include a 1% SLA credit floor for sustained >10% eviction rates.

Priya (vendor-ops): Noted, will push this back to vendor legal.

CoreWare_SalesBot: Vendor ack: "We will provide per-customer exports and the detailed pricing extract by EOD tomorrow. We are open to trial_convert_ratio = 0.5 as default. Eviction webhook: evaluating feasibility, will revert." :thumbsup:

Alisa (partnerships): Perfect. We'll reconvene after the CSV. Thanks everyone :rocket:
